content.rendered:
We are absolutely blessed to be a part of a community that takes care of one another. A huge part of that effort is with our annual Food Drive, supporting Helping Hands Food Pantry, and Sherwood families in need. As in the past, this will be a competition between the DUCKS and the BEAVERS.

 Place the food in the bin of your choice and by doing so you will be placing your vote for the Ducks or the Beavers.  The bin will be located next to the gym and cafeteria.

  • Monday: Fruits and Veggies
  • Tuesday: Meats and Proteins (stews, soup, tuna, chicken, peanut butter….)
  • Wednesday: Grains & Pasta
  • Thursday: Pantry Staples (flour, sugar, cooking oils, baking powder….)
  • Friday: Personal Hygiene items + baby items (diapers, wipes, formula…)
Thank you!
